remoteClasses.name: MoqSubscriberEndpoint

constructor.doc: Create an endpoint that subscribes to a MoQ relay broadcast. Call subscribe() to start receiving media.

params.name: url
params.doc: MoQ relay URL, including the scheme required by the relay (for example, https://cdn.moq.dev).

params.name: broadcast
params.doc: Name of the broadcast to receive. This must match the name used by the publisher (for example, bbb.hang).

properties.name: url
properties.doc: URL of the MoQ relay configured for this endpoint.

properties.name: broadcast
properties.doc: Name of the broadcast configured for this endpoint.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.doc: Connect to the configured relay, subscribe to the broadcast, and make the decoded media available to the Kurento pipeline.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.doc: Stop receiving media and disconnect from the MoQ relay.
